topics.title: Workbook Navigation, Cell Referencing ($A$1) & Basic Formulas
topics.objective: Understand relative, absolute, and mixed cell references and basic arithmetic functions (SUM, AVERAGE).
topics.exercise: Build an automated monthly budget spreadsheet with fixed cell references for tax rates.

topics.title: Logical Functions (IF, AND, OR, IFS) & Error Handling
topics.objective: Construct nested conditional evaluations and guard against #N/A and #DIV/0! using IFERROR.
topics.exercise: Create an automated employee bonus calculation table using nested IF and AND functions.

topics.title: Data Lookup (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH)
topics.objective: Perform exact and approximate lookups across tables and return matching records safely.
topics.exercise: Construct an invoice generator that dynamically populates product descriptions and unit prices.

topics.title: Pivot Tables, Slicers & Summary Aggregations
topics.objective: Group multi-row transactional datasets into multidimensional summary reports and interactive slicers.
topics.example: Rows: Region; Columns: Quarter; Values: SUM(Revenue)
topics.exercise: Generate an executive sales report summarizing quarterly performance by region and sales rep.

topics.title: What-If Analysis, Data Validation & Visualization Charts
topics.objective: Implement dropdown data validation rules, Goal Seek projections, and dynamic chart dashboards.
topics.exercise: Build an executive dashboard with interactive dropdowns and dynamic waterfall charts.
